# AgentContract Guard — PA-002

Deterministic tool execution contract enforcement and schema drift detection for autonomous AI agent networks.

## Core Capabilities
- Validates tool invocation arguments and results against standard JSON Schema definitions.
- Detects unexpected schema drift and missing required fields in multi-agent tool chains.
- Provides sub-millisecond local validation and machine-readable telemetry.

## MCP Tool Definition
- Tool Name: `validate_agent_contract`
- Input Schema:
  - `schema`: object (JSON Schema defining type, required, and properties)
  - `payload`: object (The runtime payload to evaluate)
- Output:
  - `verdict`: "CONFORMANT" | "CONFORMANT_WITH_SCHEMA_DRIFT" | "CONTRACT_VIOLATION" | "INVALID_PAYLOAD"
  - `is_valid`: boolean
  - `schema_drift_detected`: boolean
  - `errors`: array of strings
  - `payload_hash`: string (16-char SHA-256)
  - `latency_ms`: number
  - `timestamp`: string (ISO 8601 UTC)
